Affix.description: Pin an element to a fixed position on the page when scrolling. Useful for navigation bars, sidebars, or action buttons that should stay visible.

Alert.description: Display important alert messages with different severity levels (info, success, warning, danger). Supports closable behavior and custom icons.
Alert.usage:
<template>
  <bk-alert theme="info" title="This is an info alert" closable />
  <bk-alert theme="warning">
    <template #title>Custom Title</template>
    Alert description content
  </bk-alert>
</template>

AnimateNumber.description: Animate a number from one value to another with a smooth transition effect. Useful for dashboards and statistics displays.

Backtop.description: A button that appears when the user scrolls down, allowing them to quickly scroll back to the top of the page.

Badge.description: Display a badge indicator (number or dot) on the top-right corner of another element. Commonly used for notification counts.

slots.default: The element to attach the badge to

Breadcrumb.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail showing the current page's location within a hierarchical structure.

Button.description: Basic button component supporting multiple themes (default, primary, success, warning, danger), sizes, loading state, outline and text variants.
Button.usage:
<template>
  <bk-button theme="primary">Primary</bk-button>
  <bk-button theme="success" :loading="true">Loading</bk-button>
  <bk-button theme="danger" outline>Outline</bk-button>
  <bk-button text>Text Button</bk-button>
  <bk-button disabled>Disabled</bk-button>
</template>

Card.description: A container component for displaying grouped content with optional header and footer. Supports collapsible mode.

Cascader.description: Cascading selection component for selecting from a hierarchical data structure (e.g., province/city/district).

Checkbox.description: Checkbox form control for multiple selections. Includes CheckboxGroup for managing a group of checkboxes.

CodeDiff.description: Display code differences between two text blocks, similar to a git diff viewer. Supports side-by-side and unified views.

Collapse.description: Expandable/collapsible content panels. Multiple panels can be used together with accordion mode support.

ColorPicker.description: Color selection component with visual color picker interface. Returns color values in various formats.

ConfigProvider.description: Global configuration provider for setting locale, prefix, and other global settings for all child bkui-vue components.

Container.description: Grid layout system based on 24-column grid. Includes Row and Col sub-components for responsive layouts.

DatePicker.description: Date and date-range picker component. Supports date, daterange, datetime, datetimerange, month, and year modes.
DatePicker.usage:
<template>
  <bk-date-picker v-model="date" type="date" placeholder="Select date" />
  <bk-date-picker v-model="dateRange" type="daterange" />
</template>

Dialog.description: Modal dialog component for confirmations, forms, and important user interactions. Supports dragging, multi-step, and custom footer.
Dialog.usage:
<template>
  <bk-dialog v-model:is-show="visible" title="Dialog Title">
    Dialog content here
    <template #footer>
      <bk-button theme="primary" @click="visible = false">Confirm</bk-button>
    </template>
  </bk-dialog>
</template>

Divider.description: Visual separator line between content sections. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation with optional text label.

Dropdown.description: Dropdown menu component showing a list of actions or options triggered by clicking or hovering on an element.

Exception.description: Display exception/error pages with predefined types (403, 404, 500, building, empty, login). Used for error states.

FixedNavbar.description: Fixed navigation bar that stays at a fixed position on the page, typically used for quick action shortcuts.

Form.description: Form container component with built-in validation support. Works with FormItem for field-level validation, labels, and layout.
Form.usage:
<template>
  <bk-form :model="formData" :rules="rules" ref="formRef">
    <bk-form-item label="Name" property="name" required>
      <bk-input v-model="formData.name" />
    </bk-form-item>
    <bk-form-item>
      <bk-button theme="primary" @click="handleSubmit">Submit</bk-button>
    </bk-form-item>
  </bk-form>
</template>

InfoBox.description: Imperative info/confirmation dialog. Called via function: InfoBox({ title, subTitle, confirmText, onConfirm }). Not a template component.
InfoBox.usage:
<script setup>
import { InfoBox } from 'bkui-vue';

function showConfirm() {
  InfoBox({
    title: 'Confirm Delete?',
    subTitle: 'This action cannot be undone.',
    confirmText: 'Delete',
    onConfirm() {
      // handle confirm
    }
  });
}
</script>

Input.description: Text input component with support for types (text, password, number, textarea, url, email), prefix/suffix icons, clearable, and character count.
Input.usage:
<template>
  <bk-input v-model="value" placeholder="Enter text" clearable />
  <bk-input v-model="password" type="password" />
  <bk-input v-model="textarea" type="textarea" :rows="4" />
</template>

Link.description: Inline text link component with theme support and disabled state.

Loading.description: Loading spinner overlay for indicating loading state. Can be used as a component or directive (v-bk-loading).

slots.default: Content to show the loading overlay on

Menu.description: Navigation menu component supporting vertical and horizontal modes, sub-menus, groups, and collapse behavior.

Message.description: Imperative global message notification. Called via function: Message({ theme, message }). Appears at the top of the page.
Message.usage:
<script setup>
import { Message } from 'bkui-vue';

Message({ theme: 'success', message: 'Operation successful!' });
Message({ theme: 'error', message: 'Something went wrong.', delay: 5000 });
</script>

Modal.description: Base modal/overlay component used internally by Dialog and Sideslider. Provides the backdrop, animation, and z-index management.

Navigation.description: Application-level navigation component with sidebar and header layout, typically for backend admin pages.

Notify.description: Imperative notification message. Called via function: Notify({ theme, title, message, position }). Appears at a corner of the page.
Notify.usage:
<script setup>
import { Notify } from 'bkui-vue';

Notify({ theme: 'success', title: 'Success', message: 'Data saved.' });
</script>

OverflowTitle.description: Automatically show a tooltip when text content overflows its container. Useful for truncated table cells and labels.
OverflowTitle.usage:
<template>
  <bk-overflow-title>This is a very long text that may overflow its container</bk-overflow-title>
</template>

Pagination.description: Pagination control for navigating through paged data. Supports page size selection, quick jumper, and total count display.

PopConfirm.description: Popover-based confirm dialog. Shows a small confirmation popup anchored to a trigger element.

Popover.description: General-purpose popover/tooltip component. Supports click, hover, and manual triggers. Based on @floating-ui for positioning.

Popover2.description: Alternative popover implementation with additional features. Similar API to Popover.

Process.description: Process/step indicator showing workflow progress. Similar to Steps but with a different visual style.

Progress.description: Progress bar component showing completion percentage. Supports linear and circular (dashboard) modes with custom colors.

Radio.description: Radio form control for single selection. Includes RadioGroup and RadioButton sub-components.

Rate.description: Star rating input component. Supports half-star ratings and custom icons.

ResizeLayout.description: Draggable split-pane layout component. Allows users to resize two adjacent panels by dragging a divider.

Scrollbar.description: Custom scrollbar component providing consistent cross-browser scrollbar styling.

SearchSelect.description: Advanced search input with structured query builder. Supports multiple search conditions with key-value pairs and tags.

Select.description: Dropdown select component with single/multiple selection, search/filter, remote data, virtual scrolling, and custom options.
Select.usage:
<template>
  <bk-select v-model="value" filterable clearable>
    <bk-option v-for="item in options" :key="item.id" :value="item.id" :label="item.name" />
  </bk-select>
  <!-- Or use list prop -->
  <bk-select v-model="value" :list="options" id-key="id" display-key="name" />
</template>

Sideslider.description: Side panel drawer that slides in from the edge of the screen. Useful for detail views, forms, or secondary navigation.
Sideslider.usage:
<template>
  <bk-sideslider v-model:isShow="visible" title="Side Panel" width="400">
    Panel content
  </bk-sideslider>
</template>

Slider.description: Slider/range input for selecting a value or range within a defined interval.

Steps.description: Step indicator for multi-step workflows. Shows the current step and progress through a sequence.

Swiper.description: Image/content carousel component with auto-play, indicators, and navigation arrows.

Switcher.description: Toggle switch component for boolean on/off states.

Tab.description: Tab navigation component for switching between different content panels. Supports add/close, drag sorting, and card/border-card styles.
Tab.usage:
<template>
  <bk-tab v-model:active="activeTab" type="card">
    <bk-tab-panel name="tab1" label="Tab 1">Content 1</bk-tab-panel>
    <bk-tab-panel name="tab2" label="Tab 2">Content 2</bk-tab-panel>
  </bk-tab>
</template>

Table.description: Data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column resizing, virtual scrolling, and custom cell rendering. Supports both column-config and slot-based column definitions.
Table.usage:
<template>
  <!-- Column config mode -->
  <bk-table :data="tableData" :columns="columns" />
  
  <!-- Slot-based columns -->
  <bk-table :data="tableData">
    <bk-table-column label="Name" prop="name" />
    <bk-table-column label="Age" prop="age" sortable />
    <bk-table-column label="Actions">
      <template #default="{ row }">
        <bk-button text @click="handleEdit(row)">Edit</bk-button>
      </template>
    </bk-table-column>
  </bk-table>
</template>

slots.empty: Content shown when data is empty

Tag.description: Tag/chip component for displaying labels, categories, or status indicators. Supports closable, checkable, and themed variants.

TagInput.description: Input component that manages multiple tags/tokens. Supports autocomplete suggestions, custom tag rendering, and paste handling.

TimePicker.description: Time selection component for picking hours, minutes, and seconds. Supports time range selection.

Timeline.description: Vertical timeline component for displaying a sequence of events in chronological order.

Transfer.description: Transfer (shuttle) component for moving items between two lists. Supports search filtering and custom rendering.

Tree.description: Tree view component for displaying hierarchical data. Supports expand/collapse, checkbox selection, drag-and-drop, filtering, and lazy loading.

Upload.description: File upload component supporting drag-and-drop, multiple files, file list display, and custom upload logic.

VirtualRender.description: Virtual scrolling container for efficiently rendering large lists by only rendering visible items in the viewport.

slots.default: Template for each rendered item, receives { data, index } as slot props
